risks: Minimal: the study observes usual care. Risks are discomfort for nurses being observed, disturbance for patients during observation, and the observer seeing an unrecognised delirium; in that case she informs the nurse in charge and the event is recorded.
consent: Record reconciliation proceeds under the committee's waiver. Before bedside observation, patients with capacity give verbal agreement; for patients who lack capacity a family member or other consultee is asked for advice, and any sign of objection stops observation. Nurses are told which weeks include observation and may ask the observer to step away.
data: Data are recorded by bed, shift and study number; no names leave the ward; nurses are not identified in the dataset; files are kept on the hospital research drive for five years.
equity: PROGRESS-Plus: people with dementia, sensory loss, limited English or in side rooms because of infection may be screened least. These groups are pre-specified in the analysis, interpreters are used for the verbal agreement, and results are reported separately so that improvement reaches them first.
effectiveness: Success is a clear map of where screening fails and whether positive screens lead to review, precise enough to choose the first change.
efficiency: Uses existing notes and one part-time research nurse; no paperwork for ward nurses.
costs: Research nurse time funded by the division for 12 weeks; no other costs.
grants: None needed; the findings could support a hospital improvement award for the chosen change.
partnerships: Ward nurses on each shift, the geriatricians, the practice development nurse and two carers of former patients with dementia from the hospital's carers' group.
rebPath: Approved by the geriatric medicine research ethics committee on 2026-08-26 (REB-GM-2026-058) with the consent model above; reporting follows STROBE.
limitations: One ward; observer effect; dementia status from documentation.
summary: Minimal-risk observation with a waiver for records, consultee advice for bedside observation, and equity groups pre-specified.
